main.description: Subscribe to an aggregated, re-sequenced stream of labels and labeler service records from multiple upstream labelers. Each message carries a single monotonic relay-assigned seq.

cursor.description: The last known relay seq. Backfill resumes from seq > cursor.

errors.name: FutureCursor
errors.description: The provided cursor is greater than the current head seq.

labels.description: A batch of labels relayed from an upstream labeler. Each label is a full com.atproto.label.defs#label record passed through byte-faithfully (including sig). The upstreamSeq is the sequence number from the origin labeler's subscribeLabels stream.

src.description: DID of the origin labeler these labels came from.

upstreamSeq.description: Sequence number from the origin labeler's com.atproto.label.subscribeLabels stream.

labels.description: Full com.atproto.label.defs#label records, byte-faithful to upstream.

service.description: A labeler service record observed via firehose discovery, carrying the relay-minted seq and the firehose operation type.

src.description: DID of the labeler whose service record this is.

op.description: The firehose operation that triggered this event.

record.description: The full app.bsky.labeler.service record. Present for create/update ops, absent for delete.

info.description: An informational frame, e.g. OutdatedCursor when a cursor falls below the retention floor.
